goals: Turn study support into a reusable learning loop rather than a collection of prompts.
Provide Portuguese-language students with international academic-writing and formatting guidance without assuming ABNT is universal.
Add a Curator Offer rule so CS Navigator can offer a better capability path when relevant without forcing it.
Run a Human Reality Review across the catalog using KEEP, REFINE, MERGE, RETIRE, or REGISTRY-ONLY decisions.

curator_offer.wording_pt_br: Esta pergunta pode se beneficiar da curadoria do CS Navigator. Quer ver esta mesma resposta usando essa camada?
skip_for: sensitive moments where an extra prompt would distract
curator_offer.persistence_boundary: Offer behavior only applies where CS Navigator is actually active/selected by the host; installation alone does not prove execution in every future conversation.

evidence_policy: All new 0.17 capabilities start designed. Registry publication, generation, or static validation does not make them tested.
